source_interpretation: GUM Type-B bounded terms use rectangular scans; metrology repeat noise is explicitly hypothetical Gaussian conditional noise. Encoder rounding/cyclic terms are generated before calibration. All fixed calibration/tool/scale terms persist for a complete session; endpoint stop variation changes per cycle. Numbers are not taken as specifications of WineJar devices.
notes: Protocol locked before this run; all 11 jars were already viewed, so this is posthoc engineering control, not an independent jar test.
Calibration uses only separate virtual artifact measurements. Target truth is supplied only to evaluation.
Covariance from a fit is noise-only; it does not absorb common bias or artifact scale uncertainty.
No runtime marker/visible-body second observation, no training, no physical motion, no final fastening claim.
